title: APEC Finance Ministers' Meeting (first ever in Hong Kong) — day 1 of 2
source: NEWS: Hong Kong's government announced on 2025-12-12 (news.gov.hk and thestandard.com.hk, both fetched direct 2026-10-19) that Hong Kong hosts its first APEC Finance Ministers' Meeting in October 2026, but neither fetched page gives days; the Oct 20-21 days come from a search summary of SCMP's sponsored 'Spotlight on Hong Kong as APEC finance ministers gather' piece (not fetched directly) and are unverified against an APEC or HKSAR primary. SCMP reported in October 2026 that Treasury Sec. Bessent may skip it to prepare Trump's Shenzhen visit. Checked 2026-10-19
notes: Discovered during the apec-leaders-shenzhen-2026-11-18 pulse (2026-10-19). Day 1 of a two-day window per house convention. The only market-relevant question is US representation: a Bessent no-show would read as the US saving its China channel for the 11/18-19 Shenzhen leaders' meeting. Estimate widens caution only; no tracked symbol is keyed to it.
